name: HY-Motion: Roll. From a natural standing stance, abruptly drop the center of gravity and drive the body sideways into a continuous, high-momentum horizontal spin directly along the floor, executing exactly two full barrel rolls to the right. Do not pause upon completing the second roll; instead, seamlessly convert the rolling momentum to pop up into a tactical single-knee kneeling posture. Simultaneously plant the left hand flat on the floor to brace and prop the upper torso firmly upright. Instantly, extend and snap only the right arm straight forward to lock onto the front target, firing the pistol once while the gaze remains fiercely fixed ahead.
